transfer_source.description: 862 hourly San Francisco Bay Area freeway occupancy rates, 2015-2016 (Lai et al., 2017), Monash Forecasting Repository
transfer_source.window: one seeded uniform 512-observation window per series, so the panel is not tied to a single calendar interval

composition_recipe.tsi_daily_shaped: TSI: one period-24 harmonic with 2f/3f overtones and a slow amplitude envelope, drifting trend, low noise
composition_recipe.tsi_daily_weekly: TSI: two harmonics drawn from periods {24, 168}, overtones and envelopes with probability 0.5, drifting trend
composition_recipe.ets_AAdM_24: ETS(A,Ad,M) period 24: random-walk level with damped trend; multiplicative seasonality scales amplitude with level
composition_recipe.ets_MAdM_24: ETS(M,Ad,M) period 24: as above with multiplicative error
composition_recipe.seasonal_trend_breaks: Sine period 24 plus two random-location slope changes
composition_recipe.seasonal_drift_level_breaks: Sine period 24 plus linear drift and two random-location level shifts
composition_recipe.energy_residential_drift: EnergyLoad residential daily/weekly profile plus one slope change
composition_recipe.energy_commercial_drift: EnergyLoad commercial daily/weekly profile plus one slope change

protocol.transfer_protocol: same four-fold fresh-split protocol with no exclusions; same synthetic draws and slots as the M4 panel because generation depends only on length and seed
protocol.limits: benchmark-only configuration; real roles overlap across folds; three draws reused across panels; no confidence intervals; forecasting utility not measured
